Description: As Roz, I want to record a new book with ISBN, title, author and category so staff can find it in the catalogue.
Acceptance Criteria: Required fields are validated. Duplicate ISBN is rejected with a clear error. The new title appears in its section list.

Description: As Roz, I want to see stock grouped by store section so I can check availability without walking the shelves.
Acceptance Criteria: A section filter returns only that section. An unknown or empty section returns an empty list with HTTP 200. Quantity and low-stock status are visible.

Description: As Deniz, I want each second-hand copy tracked separately so condition, cost and shelf location are not lost.
Acceptance Criteria: Each copy has title, author, condition (POOR/GOOD/MINT), cost, price, shelf and status. Cost and price cannot be negative. A new copy starts AVAILABLE.

Description: As Deniz, I want to mark one used copy sold so the same physical book cannot be sold twice.
Acceptance Criteria: Only an AVAILABLE copy can be sold. A second sale request returns 409. Other copies of the same title remain unchanged. The sale is recorded in inventory_transactions.

Description: As a staff member, I want to search by part of a title or author so I can answer customer questions quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Search is case-insensitive and matches partial title or author text. ISBN search works. No match returns an empty list.

Summary: Special order for an unavailable title
Description: As Priya, I want to register a customer request for a title the store does not hold so the request is not lost at shift change.
Acceptance Criteria: Customer name and phone are required. The order starts in PENDING. It appears in the order list with the requested book. Creating a special order does not reduce current stock.

Description: As a customer, I want to reserve an in-stock book for pickup so the store holds it for me.
Acceptance Criteria: A reservation holds stock atomically. Stock cannot go below zero. Valid states are PENDING, READY, NOTIFIED and COMPLETED. Invalid transitions return 400. A 14-day due date is recorded.

Description: As Roz, I want stale reservations released after 14 days so held stock returns to the shelf.
Acceptance Criteria: MVP records a 14-day due date and releases stock when a reservation is cancelled. Stretch: a scheduled job automatically cancels expired reservations.

Description: As Roz, I want to import a supplier CSV and see low-stock titles so I can plan reorders.
Acceptance Criteria: CSV header is validated. An existing ISBN adds to quantity. A new ISBN creates a book. The low-stock list includes titles with quantity at or below threshold.

Summary: Seed data automated tests and v0.2.0 release
Description: As the team, I want repeatable seed data, automated tests and a tagged release so the demo can be reproduced.
Acceptance Criteria: Seed data is available. npm test passes. README supports a clean-checkout start. v0.2.0 tag and release notes exist.

Summary: Set up Jira board and sprint fields
Description: Create the project, board columns, story points, priority, sprint and reviewer fields.
Acceptance Criteria: Board is visible to all members. Every story has points, priority, assignee and reviewer.

Summary: Set up GitHub repository and CI
Description: Create main and develop branches, pull request template and GitHub Actions test job.
Acceptance Criteria: A pull request runs npm test. A non-author approval is required before merge.

Description: Record sprint planning, stand-up, review and retrospective notes.
Acceptance Criteria: Each memo has date, attendees, decisions, action items and owner.

Summary: Create test plan and traceability matrix
Description: Map each core story to at least two test cases and record actual results.
Acceptance Criteria: Coverage is visible for all core stories. Evidence links are recorded.

Description: Update changelog, tag the release and verify a clean checkout.
Acceptance Criteria: Release checklist is complete. Clean checkout starts without npm install. Health check passes.
